# Smart Reply Project Documentation

> Smart Reply is a system designed to generate contextual, high-accuracy automatic response suggestions for messaging and customer communication platforms using lightweight AI models.

## Overview
- Project Repository: https://github.com/mahmud-r-farhan/smart-reply
- Target Domain: https://smart-reply-delta.vercel.app/
- Core Stack: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, FastAPI, Docker

## System Architecture & Key Components
- Data Preprocessing Pipeline: Cleans, tokenizes, and structures dialogue pairs from chat logs.
- Fine-Tuning Module: Scripts and configurations for training domain-adapted seq2seq and causal LLMs for fast inference.
- Inference Engine: FastAPI-based REST service delivering real-time reply suggestions with sub-100ms latency.
- Evaluation Metrics: BLEU, ROUGE, and latency benchmarks for quality assurance.

## Getting Started
- Installation: `pip install -r requirements.txt`
- Local Server Launch: `uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000`
- Docker Deployment: `docker build -t smart-reply . && docker run -p 8000:8000 smart-reply`

## Key API Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/suggest`: Accepts a conversation context payload and returns top-k smart reply strings with confidence scores.
- `GET /health`: System operational status and model load health check.

## Platform
- Web
- Android
